diagnostic_questions.expected_wrong_answer: A forward force from the push.
diagnostic_questions.question: A puck slides on frictionless ice. What force keeps it moving?
diagnostic_questions.reveals: Naming any force shows the misconception is still held.

evidence.quote: unless acted upon by an external unbalanced force

misconception: Motion requires a continuously applied force.

remediation.action: Contrast a low-friction and a high-friction surface side by side.
remediation.rationale: Isolates friction as the cause of stopping, not the absence of force.
